passive.name: Prowl
passive.description:
Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Move Speed by 10% for 2 seconds, increased to 30% toward visible enemy champions within 1400 range.

Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack triggers a Hunt, granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds. During this time, Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed (increased to 30% toward the Hunted target) and her Takedown and Pounce are enhanced against them.

primaryAbilities.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
primaryAbilities.description: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies.  As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: <keywordMajor>Human Form:</keywordMajor> Nidalee throws her javelin, dealing <magicDamage>{{ humanminimumdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, increased up to <magicDamage>{{ humanmaximumdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> based on distance flown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
primaryAbilities.description: In human form, Nidalee lays a trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages and reveals its target. As a cougar, she jumps in a direction, dealing damage in an area where she lands.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Human Form: Nidalee places an invisible trap for 2 minutes. When an enemy walks over it, they are dealt {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second for {{ dotduration }} seconds.

{{ maxtraps }} traps may be active at once.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
primaryAbilities.description: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with Attack Speed for a short duration. As a cougar, she claws in a direction, dealing damage to enemies in front of her.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: <keywordMajor>Human Form:</keywordMajor> Nidalee restores <healing>{{ totalhealing }} Health</healing> increased up to <healing>{{ maxhealing }}</healing> based on missing Health and grants them <attackSpeed>{{ bonusas*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for {{ asduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
primaryAbilities.description: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: While in Human Form, applying Hunted refreshes this Ability's Cooldown.

Human Form: Nidalee transforms into Cougar Form, gaining melee Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.

Cougar Form: Nidalee transforms into Human Form, gaining ranged Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allSpellRecords.name: Prowl
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Nidalee starts with a rank in Aspect of the Cougar. 

Nidalee gains @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS@% Move Speed for 2 seconds when entering Brush, increased to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS*3@% Move Speed while moving toward enemy champions.

Hitting champions or jungle monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack marks them as Hunted for 4 seconds. While an enemy is Hunted, they are revealed with True Sight and Nidalee gains @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS@% Move Speed, increased to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS*3@% Move Speed toward the Hunted enemy.

allSpellRecords.name: Pounce / Bushwhack
allSpellRecords.summary: Nidalee jumps in a direction, dealing damage in an area where she lands.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Cougar Form: Nidalee pounces, dealing @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:TotalPounceDamage@ magic damage to enemies surrounding where she lands. Killing a unit in Cougar Form reduces this Ability's Cooldown to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PounceCooldown@ seconds.

Pouncing at a Hunted enemy can be done from a greater distance and reduces this Ability's Cooldown to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PounceCooldown@ seconds.
